decisionsTitle: «Atașează traseul (GPX)» — the organizers' message to an event's participants can carry the event's route as a GPX file
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-19, on a phone, two days before Saturday's race:** «vreau să pot pune în mail și traseul cursei GPX» — he wants the race's route, the GPX file, in the email he writes to the participants this week.

**What was there.** The event editor stores one GPX per event (§718): the file of «Traseul», uploaded into the site's own store (`events.route_gpx`), which the event page offers as «Descarcă traseul (GPX)». «Trimite un mesaj participanților» (§364) sends the organizers' own words, and four ticks put something of the platform's under them: «Cere reconfirmarea», «Trimite și numărul de concurs și codul QR» (§943), «Trimite și linkul pentru semnarea declarației» (§947) and «Include programul evenimentului» (§958). To give the runners the file, the organizers could only paste the page's address into the body and hope they found the download on it.

**Decision.** One more tick in the composer, after «Include programul evenimentului» and off by default: **«Atașează traseul (GPX)»** / "Attach the route (GPX)", with one line of help — «Fiecare email are atașat fișierul GPX de pe pagina evenimentului și, sub cuvintele tale, un link spre el.» It is the exact twin of §958: about nobody in particular, so the send puts the flag `includeRouteGpx` on **every** row it queues — every audience, every registration state, a test row too — and on the club's one copy (§419), and names the tick in its audit row; anything but a literal `true` is no. A send to the people ticked (§945) carries it like any send, and hands it back to the boxes afterwards with the words, so a trial is followed by the same message to everybody. The question before «Trimite» says it in one line — «Emailul are atașat traseul, ca fișier GPX.» — and a step of the guide's task names the tick.

**Offered only when there is a file.** The tick is drawn only while the event has a GPX its page offers — the stored file, while the environment has a store to serve it from (`content/events/route-gpx.ts#offeredRouteGpx`, the event page's own condition); without one there is no box at all — not §958's disabled box with its sentence: most events have no GPX and never will (a group run, a meetup), and a greyed tick on every one of their composers would be noise. A tick posted for an event with no GPX — a forged post, a file removed since the page was drawn — is ignored by the send under the event's lock: no flag, nothing in the audit row.

**The file is read when the email leaves, and stored nowhere.** The outbox row keeps the flag beside the words, never the file, its name or its address — an attachment is rendered when the message is sent and never stored in the outbox, as the signed declaration is (§95). As each message leaves, the renderer reads the event's GPX as it stands then and its bytes from the store, and attaches them under the file's own name — the event page's download name, `routeGpxFileName` — typed `application/gpx+xml`, as `/api/media` and R2 serve it: a file replaced after the press leaves as the new one, and an event left with no GPX sends the message with neither the file nor the line — exactly the message of a send without the tick. A batch reads one file from the store once, however many of the send's rows it carries; a read that gave nothing is asked again by the next row.

**The line and its link, so a mail app that hides attachments still gives it.** Under the organizers' words — and under the number and the desk code of §943, above the programme of §958, the QR and the buttons — each half says in its own language «Traseul e atașat acestui email, ca fișier GPX. Îl poți descărca și de aici:» / "The route is attached to this email as a GPX file. You can also download it here:", then the link under the file's name. The link is the very address the event page's «Descarcă traseul (GPX)» opens (`getStorage().publicUrl`, as `EventRoute` draws it): from the environment, never a host typed in the code — `APP_BASE_URL` with `/api/media/…` on a developer's disk and in the tests, and the bucket's public address (`R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL`) on QA and production, where Cloudflare serves the file as it serves the page's (§66). The words are the templates', each language its own; nothing is typed into the organizers' text.

**The line says «atașat» only when the file is attached** — the volunteer agreement's rule (§758: its sentence is said only when the PDF rides along). A store that gives no file — a key gone, a bucket having a bad minute — never blocks or fails a participant's email: the message leaves with the link alone, «Traseul, ca fișier GPX, îl descarci de aici:» / "Download the route as a GPX file here:", and the outbox's log says so (`console.warn`, with the row's id). The club's copy keeps §320's rule — a copy carries no attachment, so for it the store is not even asked — and keeps the line with the link, which names nobody, in the same link-alone words.

**The preview** draws the line as a participant's email carries it, the file said attached, with the link, as soon as the box is ticked; nothing is read from the store, attached or queued for a preview. Without the tick, or without a GPX, the preview is what it was.

**What the tick does not touch.** No state, place, hold, deadline, number or token: the send writes the flag, and its audit row names the tick — never the file. No other message type reads the flag, whatever its payload holds. Who may send it is as before: whoever may write to the participants (`canMessageParticipants`, BR-REQ-060-01), asserted again by the send and the preview. No migration, no new dependency, no new upload: the file is the one the editor already stores.

**Not done.** The GPX on the automatic emails — the confirmation, the reminder — which the owner did not ask for and which every runner would then carry several times; a line on «Mesaje trimise» saying a send carried the route (its audit row does); the file's name or size beside the tick (the preview shows the name); the route of the volunteers' messages; a site-hosted address for the file on production, which would need `/api/media` to serve R2's objects through a function, where §66 decided that Cloudflare serves them, never a function.

**Held by** `tests/unit/notifications/organizer-message-route-gpx.test.ts` (the flag's reader; `offeredRouteGpx` with and without a store; the line in the message — one a half, each in its own language, the link under the file's name, «atașat» only when attached, after the words and §943's lines, escaped; the ticked message with its lines taken out is the unticked one; the club's copy with the link alone; every other message type the same with the field and without; the words in both catalogues within 200 characters and a step of the guide; the files that may name the flag), `tests/integration/notifications/participant-message-route-gpx.test.ts` (the send flags every row of every audience and state and the club's copy and names the tick in its audit row, stores nothing of the file, and flags nothing unticked or for an event with no GPX; the email as it leaves: the file attached with its name, its type and its bytes, the line with the event page's own link; a file replaced after the press; no GPX left, the unticked message; a store that throws or has lost the file, the link alone, a warning, and the outbox still sends every message; one store read a batch; the club's copy without the file and without asking the store; a forged flag on another type; the preview; the action, the people ticked and the tick handed back after a trial; the roles that may not write) and `participant-message-route-gpx-page.test.ts` (the composer's page in Romanian and in English: the tick drawn with a GPX and absent without one; the question's line only for a press that posts the tick; the tick as a trial left it); in a browser, `tests/e2e/participant-message.spec.ts`.
changelogLine: - **«Atașează traseul (GPX)» in «Trimite un mesaj participanților»** — one more tick in the composer, shown when the event has a GPX file: every email of the send then carries the route's GPX attached, with one line and a link to the same file under your words, in both languages, so a phone that hides attachments still gets it; the preview shows the line and the question before «Trimite» says it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 27 (what the platform adds under the organizers' words): given the composer of «Trimite un mesaj participanților» for an event whose page offers a GPX (`events.route_gpx`, while the environment has a store), then it offers the tick «Atașează traseul (GPX)», off by default; for an event without one the tick is not drawn, and a tick posted for such an event is ignored by the send. Given a send with it ticked, then every row the send queues — every audience, every registration state, a test row too — and the club's copy carry the flag `includeRouteGpx`, never the file, its name or its address, and the send's audit row names the tick; an unticked send writes neither, and anything but a literal `true` is no. Given an ORGANIZER_MESSAGE whose row carries the flag, when it renders, then the event's GPX as it is at that moment is read from the store and attached under the file's own name (`routeGpxFileName`), typed `application/gpx+xml`, and each half carries, after the organizers' words (and after the number and the desk code of a send that also ticked «Trimite și numărul de concurs și codul QR»), one line in that half's own language saying the route is attached as a GPX file, with a link — the same address the event page's «Descarcă traseul (GPX)» opens, derived from the environment, no host in the code — under the file's name, in the HTML and in the plain text; with no GPX then, the message is exactly the unticked one, with no line and no file; when the store gives no file, the message still leaves, with the line giving the link alone and no attachment, and the outbox logs it; the club's copy carries no attachment, the store is not asked for it, and its line gives the link alone. No other message type attaches or draws anything from the flag; the composer's preview draws the line with the file said attached when the box is ticked and is unchanged when it is not; and the question before «Trimite» says in one line that the email has the route attached, only for a press that posts the tick. Verification: unit `notifications/organizer-message-route-gpx.test.ts`; integration `notifications/participant-message-route-gpx.test.ts`, `notifications/participant-message-route-gpx-page.test.ts`; e2e `participant-message.spec.ts` (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
